name: Renamer
description: Bulk-rename and optionally relocate Cove media from metadata using configurable naming templates. Renames the file on disk and updates its Cove database record together, with a read-only preview, a whole-library dry run, cross-drive moves that never lose a file, and one-click undo.
author: alextomas955

versions.changelog: Initial release: template-based bulk renaming of videos and images with preview, whole-library dry run, destination routing across drives, and undo, over the extension API.
